comment.narrative: A modest positive shift in the governments willingness to engage with CSOs however still limited in areas on political human rights and democratisation topics. The CSO Meter for 2022 released in 2023 indicates a gradual increase in the involvement of CSOs in consultations in Azerbaijan.
